title: narcissus triandrus var. macleayi
intro: Narcissus triandrus var. macleayi, commonly known as the Mount Macleay Daffodil or Thalassia, is a variety of the Mediterranean daffodil that is native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus triandrus var. macleayi include its ability to reduce anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression, due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including galantamine and homocholine, have been shown to have acetylcholinesterase inhibitory activity, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
